lua-seeded-loot#A.why: Crashes with modulo by zero: lines are consumed by three io.lines loops, and it does only one roll.

lua-seeded-loot#B.why: Reads only the seed, does a single roll and prints all counts as 0.

unity-so-inventory#A.why: TryAdd fires the change event even when nothing changed, slots are private and not serialized, and the SO shares a file with other classes.

unity-so-inventory#B.why: TryAdd always raises the change event (even when nothing was added), and slots are built in a MonoBehaviour constructor.

unity-json-save#A.why: Delete-then-Move leaves a window with no save (not atomic), and a null FromJson result is returned instead of defaults.

unity-json-save#B.why: Temp file plus File.Replace/Move, persistentDataPath, defaults on a missing, corrupt or null load.

lua-grid-paths-mod#A.why: Indexes strings as grid[i][j] (nil), so blocked cells are never seen and the counts are wrong.

lua-grid-paths-mod#B.why: Correct DP with modulo at each step; passes all tests.

gd-combat-math#A.why: hp_after_hits includes the starting HP, and the cooldown formula is wrong.

gd-combat-math#B.why: cooldown_left_ms returns cooldown_ms instead of 0 when the skill was never used.

un-explosion-nonalloc#A.why: AddExplosionForce called with a Vector3 force (no such overload), and the Rigidbody comes from GetComponent instead of attachedRigidbody.

un-explosion-nonalloc#B.why: Uses GetComponent<Rigidbody> instead of attachedRigidbody (misses compound bodies), and the LOS ray to radius can hit walls behind the target.

ue-weapon-data-async#A.why: Adds paths only if the soft ptr IsValid (already loaded), so nothing loads; wrong delegate signature; no GetPrimaryAssetId or SetWeaponData.

ue-weapon-data-async#B.why: Asks a question back instead of writing any code.

lua-ini-parser#A.why: Syntax error (unclosed table.sort paren), and the errors output format is wrong.

lua-ini-parser#B.why: The empty-key check matches every line, so all lines count as errors; wrong error output format.

gds-enemy-fsm#A.why: Full API correct, tween-based knockback; passes all 11 tests.

gds-enemy-fsm#B.why: Full API correct with eased tween; passes all 11 tests.

unreal-enhanced-input-character#A.why: Invented APIs (FRotationToEuler, EnhancedInputMapper.h), a BindAction with no object, and garbage movement math.

unreal-enhanced-input-character#B.why: Jump() calls itself (infinite recursion), no bOrientRotationToMovement, wrong API macro.

lua-utf8-names#A.why: Syntax error (the stray ':..'), and it calls utf8.codepoint on every byte index.

lua-utf8-names#B.why: Rambling drafts using the non-existent utf8.chars, a line pattern that never iterates lines, and no correct output.

ue-hitscan-weapon#A.why: Invented APIs (GetViewLocation(out), MakeDamageEvent), no ApplyPointDamage, no immediate first shot.

ue-hitscan-weapon#B.why: EndPlay(const EEndPlayReason) does not compile, wrong include path, no immediate or remaining-delay fire, bogus spread.

godot-health-component#A.why: Correct Godot 4 component with clamping, an is_dead guard and the died.connect(queue_free) example.

godot-health-component#B.why: Health goes negative, and the example connects died on owner (the parent has no such signal).

gd-tile-chunks#A.why: Floor division and positive wrap correct, row-major radius list; passes all tests.

gd-tile-chunks#B.why: chunk_of uses integer division before floor, so negative tiles get the wrong chunk.

godot-settings-autoload#A.why: Works: user:// JSON, linear_to_db, DisplayServer window mode; minor gaps (no file error check, loaded values unclamped).

godot-settings-autoload#B.why: Correct ConfigFile with error check, Master bus by name, DisplayServer mode; loaded values unclamped.

lua-split-fields#A.why: table.insert gets gsub's two return values and errors; no output.

lua-split-fields#B.why: Prints a stray '#fields:' prefix, and the trim pattern leaves trailing spaces.

lv-seeded-starfield#A.why: Palette entries are not wrapped in tables, so star.color.r indexes a number and crashes.

lv-seeded-starfield#B.why: Palette stores 0-255 bytes instead of colorFromBytes floats, so colours are wrong.

gd-chat-command#A.why: Uses the non-existent String.is_alpha, so valid commands return {}; amount validation is also flawed.

gd-chat-command#B.why: Uses the non-existent String.match_with_regex, so valid commands fail.

unreal-health-component#A.why: Logic works, but UCLASS lacks BlueprintSpawnableComponent (Blueprints cannot add it), and the damage delta sign does not match heal.

unreal-health-component#B.why: Handler defined with UDamageType* while declared with const UDamageType* (compile error); non-existent include.

unreal-health-component#C.why: Handler signature does not match OnTakeAnyDamage (non-const UDamageType*), so AddDynamic fails; bogus include.

un-awaitable-dash#A.why: Obsolete velocity/drag, non-existent Awaitable.WaitForSeconds, returns Task<bool>, never applies dash speed, no cancellation.

un-awaitable-dash#B.why: TryDash returns Task<bool>, never sets dash velocity, no destroyCancellationToken.

un-awaitable-dash#C.why: Gravity is never disabled, it keeps the dash's horizontal velocity instead of the previous one, and damping is cached in Awake.

lua-bitmask#A.why: Crashes on parse; set logic is wrong and ^ is float power, not xor.

lua-bitmask#B.why: Float arithmetic with no integer bit ops; popcount and output are broken.

lua-bitmask#C.why: Float math, misuse of string.match captures, and %X on floats; no output.

lv-highscore-file#A.why: game is local, love.filesystem.load/io.open misused, and space is polled with isDown in update.

lv-highscore-file#B.why: Calls the non-existent love.filesystem.loadFile; uses io.open and isDown polling.

lv-highscore-file#C.why: love.filesystem.read returns (contents, size), but the code parses the size instead of the contents.

un-anim-channel#A.why: Obsolete FindObjectOfType and velocity, no damped SetFloat, lambda unsubscribe that never removes.

un-anim-channel#B.why: Searches for ProfilerMarker instead of PlayerMarker (compile error); speed uses only the x axis.

un-anim-channel#C.why: Searches for ProfilerMarker, lambda unsubscribe broken, no damped SetFloat overload.

un-anim-channel#D.why: Speed uses only |x| rather than the XZ magnitude, no RequireComponent, and it skips all updates when no player exists (checker's PlayerMarker complaint is wrong).

godot-wave-spawner#A.why: Wave completion is checked only once when spawning ends, so a wave with live enemies never clears; add_child to the parent during _ready fails.

godot-wave-spawner#B.why: Completion is checked once after the spawns finish and never again when enemies die, so waves stall.

ue-replicated-inventory#A.why: Malformed TwoParams delegate, ServerUseItem_Implementation missing its parameter, component has no HasAuthority().

ue-replicated-inventory#B.why: Server RPCs return int32 (UHT error), SetIsReplicated in the ctor, malformed delegate macro.

gd-duration-strings#A.why: Script fails to load: result is declared inside branches.

gd-duration-strings#B.why: Parse is wrong: uses the non-existent is_valid_uint, and minutes in H:MM:SS are added as seconds.

gd-duration-strings#C.why: Accepts signs via is_valid_int and the final recomputation ignores validation; parse tests fail.

gd-grid-bfs#A.why: Correct neighbour order and BFS with edge cases; passes all tests.

gd-grid-bfs#B.why: The typed Array[String] parameter rejects the plain Array the task specifies; fails 5 of 8 tests.

gd-grid-bfs#C.why: A nested func inside a function does not parse; the script fails to load.

unity-health-iframes#A.why: Correct i-frames, single died, UnityEvents, Awake init; HP can go negative in the changed event.

unity-health-iframes#B.why: C# events cannot be hooked in the Inspector as asked; init in Start; HP not clamped at 0.

gds-inventory-save#A.why: Correct API and ConfigFile load/save; passes all 15 tests.

gds-inventory-save#B.why: Correct API and ConfigFile load/save; passes all 15 tests.

gds-inventory-save#C.why: Calls the non-existent ConfigFile.get_section_names/get_properties_in_section, so load_from errors.

gds-inventory-save#D.why: Calls the non-existent ConfigFile.get_properties_section, so load_from errors.

un-uitk-hud#A.why: Sets the progress bar value to a 0..1 fraction without setting lowValue/highValue (range 0..max not applied); depends on an unassigned doc field.

un-uitk-hud#B.why: Progress bar range is never set to 0..max (value written as a 0..1 fraction), and max is not rounded up in the title.

lua-damage-totals#A.why: string.match returns a string, re-matching it gives nil names and crashes; tie order not preserved.

lua-damage-totals#B.why: Same parse crash (nil table index); unstable sort with no first-appearance tiebreak.

unity-projectile-pool#A.why: Releases a GameObject into an ObjectPool<Projectile>, createFunc returns a GameObject, Destroy is called on pooled objects, obsolete velocity.

unity-projectile-pool#B.why: createFunc returns a GameObject for ObjectPool<Projectile> (compile error), and Destroy(gameObject, lifetime) defeats pooling.

unity-projectile-pool#C.why: No guard against double Release (multiple collisions or lifetime in the same step throw with collectionCheck); both MonoBehaviours in one file.

lv-sliding-puzzle#A.why: grid and moves are locals (tests see nil), rng:next does not exist, and the shuffle assumes the blank is at 4,4.

lv-sliding-puzzle#B.why: Locals instead of globals; rng:integer does not exist, so the shuffle crashes.

love-topdown-shooter#A.why: Crashes at load: love.mouse.setAllowedMouseMotion does not exist.

love-topdown-shooter#C.why: Spawning via getTime()%1<0.02 is frame-rate dependent (0, 1 or several per second), and restart does not reset the player.

ue-async-terrain#A.why: Captures raw this in the worker, invented GridToWorldPosition, ignores seed, no stale-job id, refuses re-generation.

ue-async-terrain#B.why: Raw this captured in the worker, invented GridToWorld, no seeded FRandomStream offset, Generate ignored while busy.

lv-dev-console#A.why: console/game are locals, 'grave' is not LOVE's key name, backspace breaks UTF-8, echo/add output is wrong.

lv-dev-console#B.why: The 'grave' key never toggles; add changes gold instead of printing the sum; byte-based backspace (and #bytes on a number errors).

lv-dev-console#C.why: Same 'grave' and backspace bugs, plus words is a string, so command parsing breaks.

lv-dev-console#D.why: Locals, the non-existent 'backtick' key, love.getWidth crash, broken backspace and echo.

gd-score-ranking#A.why: Comparator sorts score ascending, and String.pad_right does not exist.

gd-score-ranking#B.why: lpad pads the wrong side, and the and/or precedence bug makes the rank wrong.

love-state-machine#A.why: Resuming from pause calls play.enter, which restarts the run; the player cannot move.

love-state-machine#B.why: Movement uses an ever-growing accumulated_dt, Space instead of Enter starts the game, resuming resets the run.

unity-rigidbody-controller#A.why: Obsolete Rigidbody.velocity, jump force applied in Update, jump not derived from height.

unity-rigidbody-controller#B.why: Jump AddForce is applied in Update (physics outside FixedUpdate), and jump is a raw force, not a configurable height.

unity-rigidbody-controller#C.why: Jump uses an Impulse (mass-dependent height), and an airborne Space press stays queued and fires on landing.

gds-ability-charges#A.why: After one charge returns, the timer is not restarted while still below max, so only one charge ever recharges.

gds-ability-charges#B.why: Timer is not restarted after a recharge while below max, so the second charge never returns.

godot-platformer-coyote#B.why: Correct Godot 4 controller with acceleration, project gravity, coyote time, jump buffer and jump cut.

lv-camera-trail#A.why: player/camera/trail/marker are locals, so tests see nil, and marker gets the x value for both coordinates.

lv-camera-trail#B.why: Crashes on the non-existent love.window.setModeModes; marker is assigned a number.

lv-camera-trail#C.why: Logic is right, but player, camera, trail and marker are locals, not the required globals.

lv-camera-trail#D.why: Locals instead of globals, and marker = screenToWorld(...) stores a number, so drawing crashes.

unity-navmesh-patrol#A.why: Uses hit.collider when the raycast did not hit (NullReferenceException), no null player or empty waypoint handling.

unity-navmesh-patrol#B.why: LOS mask depends on a 'Player' layer (NameToLayer -1 otherwise), so a tag-only player is never seen; no initial destination.

un-cinemachine3-zone#A.why: Correct CM3 namespace, class, priority, impulse and CompareTag; event raised only when a camera is assigned.

un-cinemachine3-zone#B.why: Correct CM3 usage, Priority.Value, impulse, static event, CompareTag.

unreal-coin-pickup#A.why: Garbage handler signature (Uclass, VEC3), invented GetPlayerState/IsAuthority on actor, score never added.

unreal-coin-pickup#B.why: Same invalid handler signature and invented APIs; does not compile.

unreal-coin-pickup#C.why: Actor is not set to replicate, so the server's Destroy does not remove the coin on clients; sound plays only on the server.

lua-calendar#A.why: Misuses match captures as a table, the patterns fail, nothing is printed; float diff.

lua-calendar#B.why: Pattern needs 5 adjacent non-space groups and never matches; no output.

lua-calendar#C.why: os.time called with a string raises an error.

lua-fnv1a#A.why: Uses ^ (float power) instead of xor plus float modulo; format errors.

lua-fnv1a#B.why: % 2^64 turns h into a float, so the hex format errors, and the bucket ignores unsigned semantics.

lua-fnv1a#C.why: Decimal literal becomes a float, ^ is not xor, format errors.

lua-fnv1a#D.why: Decimal offset literal is a float and % 2^64 is float, so ~ and the format error.

lv-physics-jump-ball#A.why: Treats getLinearVelocity/getPosition as tables, a fixture options table, globals as locals; crashes.

lv-physics-jump-ball#B.why: Invented table-based newBody API; crashes immediately.

un-input-actions#A.why: Aims by physics raycast against colliders instead of the camera ray vs horizontal plane at character height; no rotation over empty space.

un-input-actions#B.why: Uses Physics.Raycast against colliders rather than the required horizontal-plane intersection, so aim is wrong or missing off-geometry.

ue-save-subsystem#A.why: UProgressSaveGame::StaticLoadObject does not compile, and SaveGameToSlot runs on a background thread with raw this instead of AsyncSaveGameToSlot.

ue-save-subsystem#B.why: TwoParams macro with one param, invented FGameplayTagSaveDelegate and include, OnSaveCompleted never broadcast.
